description: Log in on the web at the login page using a username and password field, then assert the dashboard heading is visible.
Send a GET request to the orders API and check the response status is confirmed.
Log in on the web, then check the orders API says the order is confirmed.
Check the application log file has no ERROR lines in the last hour.
Open the mobile app, tap the login button, and assert the home screen is visible.
Navigate to the checkout page on the web, then check the application logs show no anomalies during checkout.
Send a POST request to create a new order, then check the application logs show no errors for that order.
Log in on the web, place an order through the orders API, then open the mobile app and confirm the order appears in the order history screen.
Send an SMS text message to the on-call engineer if the health check fails.
